No web search done: generic item, Gowans past results answer it directly. Gowans mixed slab lots sell about $20 to $60; confirmed Huon pine slabs $30 to $155 (median about $55 to $65); 3 SLABS OF HUON PINE reached $220 once. eBay sold not needed.
viewing_check: Smell and plane or scrape a clean patch on the pale slabs: Huon pine has a strong sweet oily scent and fine even grain, which would lift value to roughly $100 to $220 for the lot; Tasmanian oak or similar is about $20 to $60. Check splits and length, and whether the red board is real cedar (scent, light weight).
